texts.title: Bauta – web mode
texts.login_text: Enter the code shown in Bauta on your phone, under Settings → Web mode or in the notification.
texts.login_wrong: Wrong code. Check the phone and try again.
texts.login_wait: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
texts.login_closed: Too many wrong attempts, so web mode has been turned off. Turn it on again on the phone to get a new code.
texts.offline: No contact with the phone. Web mode may have been turned off – turn it on again in the app and reload the page.
texts.saved_note: Changes are saved straight to the phone.
texts.name: Name
texts.error_generic: Could not save. Check the fields and try again.
texts.profiles_help: Each weekday has a day type, e.g. Weekday or Weekend. Click a weekday to move it to that day type.
texts.profile_has_days: A day type that applies to weekdays cannot be deleted. Move the days to another day type first.
texts.profile_empty: No meals in this day type yet.
texts.meals_help: Meals are used in the day types. Enter kcal and macros yourself, or add ingredients from the Swedish Food Agency and they are calculated.
texts.meal_ingredients_help: With ingredients, kcal and macros are calculated automatically.
texts.meal_search_hint: Search food, e.g. chicken breast or oats
texts.meal_totals: Total: %1$s kcal · protein %2$s g · fat %3$s g · carbs %4$s g
texts.meal_unused: Not used in any day type.
texts.meal_delete_text: The meal is removed from all day types.
texts.food_unavailable: No contact with the Swedish Food Agency. The search needs the phone to be online.
texts.food_no_results: No matches. Try another or shorter word.
texts.food_source: Source: the Swedish Food Agency's food database, licence CC BY 4.0.
texts.tasks_help: Tasks are reminders besides the meals, e.g. weighing or preparing lunch boxes.
texts.task_measure_help: Choose measures if the reminder should open a measurement.
texts.workouts_help: Your workout library. Build workouts here and add them to programs under Programs.
texts.workout_differs: This workout differs from the same workout in: %1$s.
texts.workout_delete_library: The workout is also removed from all programs that use it. Completed workouts are kept.
texts.workout_delete_program: The workout is removed from the program. It stays in the workout library.
texts.sets_need_work: At least one working set is needed.
texts.programs_help: A program is a series of workouts. The active program shows on Home in the app.
texts.program_empty: No workouts in the program yet.
texts.program_delete_text: The program and its workouts are deleted. Completed workouts are kept.
texts.exercises_help: All exercises in the app. The built-in ones have instructions; you create your own here and can change them whenever you like.
texts.exercise_builtin_note: Built-in exercises cannot be changed. If you need a variant, create your own exercise.
texts.exercise_delete_text: The exercise disappears from the list. Workouts that already contain it and your history are not affected.

meals.name: Weekend breakfast
meals.description: Scrambled eggs, rye bread and an orange

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switch
exercises.instructions:
Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90°, one leg in front and the other to the side.
Rotate both knees over to the other side, without using your hands if you can.
Sit tall in each position.
One switch counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Ab machine
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the machine and grip the handles.
Roll forward with the abdominal muscles, not with the arms.
Return under control.

exercises.name: Ab wheel
exercises.instructions:
Kneel with the wheel in front of you.
Roll forward as far as you can with a braced stomach and straight back.
Pull back with your stomach. Do not arch your back.

exercises.name: Air bike
exercises.instructions:
Pedal and push/pull the handles at the same time.
The harder you work, the greater the resistance.
Well suited to intervals.

exercises.name: Archer push-up
exercises.instructions:
Push-up position with the hands very wide apart.
Lower towards one hand while the other arm stays straight.
Push up and switch sides.
A step towards the one-arm push-up.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.instructions:
Start with the dumbbells in front of your face, palms facing you.
Rotate the palms outwards while you press up.
Rotate back on the way down.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-ups (machine)
exercises.instructions:
Set the counterweight – more weight means more help.
Knees or feet on the platform, grip the handles.
Pull yourself up and lower under control.
Record the counterweight; reduce it as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions:
Place your hips against the pad and your feet under the supports.
Lower the upper body with a straight back.
Rise until the body is straight – no further.
Harder variant: hold a weight plate against your chest.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.instructions:
Anchor the band at elbow height and stand side-on to it.
Elbow bent 90° against your side, ideally with a towel under the arm.
Rotate the forearm out without the elbow leaving your body.
Return slowly. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Band internal rotation
exercises.instructions:
Anchor the band at elbow height and stand side-on to it.
Elbow bent 90° against your side.
Rotate the forearm in towards your stomach and return slowly.
It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.instructions:
Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with straight arms.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.
It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Band shoulder dislocate
exercises.instructions:
Hold a band or a broomstick with a wide grip in front of you.
Bring the straight arms over your head and down behind your back.
Return the same way.
Take a wider grip if it feels restricted. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
exercises.instructions:
Loop a resistance band over the bar and put one foot or knee in it.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower under control to straight arms.
Switch to a thinner band when you can do 10–12 reps.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.instructions:
Stand with the bar on straight arms, underhand grip.
Bend the elbows and lift the bar towards the shoulders.
Elbows still by your sides, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.instructions:
Upper back against a bench, the bar over the hips (preferably with a pad).
Feet on the floor, knees about 90° at the top.
Push the hips up until the body is straight from knee to shoulder, squeeze your glutes.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.instructions:
Bend forward at the hips with a straight back, the bar hanging on straight arms.
Pull the bar towards the lower stomach with the elbows close to the body.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top and lower under control.
Common mistake: standing up and jerking with the body.

exercises.name: Barbell shrugs
exercises.instructions:
Stand with the bar on straight arms in front of the thighs.
Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears.
Hold briefly and lower under control. Do not roll the shoulders.

exercises.name: Bench dips
exercises.instructions:
Hands on a bench behind you, legs forward.
Lower yourself by bending the elbows to about 90°.
Press up. Easier with bent legs.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.instructions:
Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, pull your shoulder blades together and unrack the bar with straight arms.
Lower under control to the lower part of the chest with the elbows about 45° from the body.
Press up to straight arms without lifting your hips off the bench.
Common mistake: bouncing the bar off the chest or letting the elbows flare straight out to the sides.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.instructions:
On all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips.
Extend the opposite arm and leg until horizontal, keeping the back still.
Hold for a second, return and switch sides.
Common mistake: rotating the hips or arching the back.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.instructions:
Stand shoulder width apart with the toes turned slightly out.
Sit down between your heels with a straight back and knees following the toes.
Go as deep as you can with heels down, then stand up.
Common mistake: knees caving in.

exercises.name: Box jumps
exercises.instructions:
Stand in front of a stable box.
Jump up and land softly with both feet.
Step down – do not jump down backwards.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.instructions:
Rear foot on a bench, front foot a long step forward.
Lower the rear knee towards the floor with an upright upper body.
Press up through the front heel.
Do all repetitions on one leg, then the other.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions:
From standing, put your hands on the floor and jump back to a push-up position.
Do a push-up (optional), jump the feet in.
Jump up with the arms overhead.

exercises.name: Cable crossover
exercises.instructions:
Set the pulleys high, take a handle in each hand and step forward.
Lean slightly forward with a small bend in the elbows.
Bring the hands in an arc down and together in front of the body.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.instructions:
Kneel in front of a high pulley with the rope by your head.
Roll the upper body down by tightening your stomach.
Come up slowly. Hips still.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.instructions:
Stand facing a low pulley with a bar or rope.
Bend the arms and pull towards the shoulders.
Let it down under control.

exercises.name: Cable external rotation
exercises.instructions:
Set the cable at elbow height and stand side-on to the machine.
Elbow at 90° against your side.
Rotate the forearm out and return slowly.
Light weight and a controlled tempo. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
exercises.instructions:
Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley.
Hold on to the machine and kick the leg straight back with a squeezed glute.
Return slowly. Do both legs.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand side-on to a low pulley with the handle in the far hand.
Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions:
Get on all fours.
Round your back up towards the ceiling and drop your head.
Then slowly arch your back and lift your gaze.
Move calmly with your breathing.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.instructions:
Lie face down on an incline bench with the dumbbells hanging.
Pull the dumbbells towards the hips and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower under control. The bench takes the load off your back.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions:
Sit on your heels with your knees apart.
Fold forward and stretch your arms out in front of you on the floor.
Rest your forehead and breathe calmly into your back.
Walk your hands to one side to stretch the side of the back.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.instructions:
Hang with the palms facing you, shoulder-width grip.
Pull yourself up until the chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself all the way down between each repetition.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your side with your knees bent and a band around your thighs.
Keep the feet together and lift the top knee like a clam opening.
Lower slowly. The pelvis should not roll back.
Strengthens the glute on the outside of the hip.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.instructions:
Like the bench press but with the grip about shoulder width.
Elbows close to the body on the way down.
Press up with focus on the triceps.

exercises.name: Close-grip pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Use a narrow V-handle.
Pull the handle towards the chest with the elbows close to the body.
Let it up under control.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the elbow against the inside of the thigh.
Lift the dumbbell towards the shoulder.
Lower slowly. Do both arms.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.instructions:
Side plank with the top leg on a bench and the bottom leg under the bench.
Lift your hips so your body is straight.
Hold the position.
Easier: the knee on the bench instead of the foot. Strengthens the inner thigh.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.instructions:
Put one knee against the wall (or couch) with the shin running up the wall.
Place the other foot in front of you in a lunge.
Raise your upper body and squeeze your glutes until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip and thigh.
Switch legs halfway through.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with bent knees.
Roll the shoulders up from the floor by tightening your stomach.
Lower slowly. Do not pull on your neck.

exercises.name: Cuban press
exercises.instructions:
Stand with very light dumbbells and pull your elbows up to shoulder height.
Rotate the forearms up so the hands point at the ceiling.
Press overhead and return the same way.
It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.instructions:
Cycle at an even pace.
Record time and, if you like, distance.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with the arms up and the knees at 90°.
Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg, lower back against the floor.
Return and switch sides.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with straight arms and a shoulder-width grip.
Let the shoulders rise towards the ears without losing your grip.
Breathe calmly and hang as long as you can hold a good grip.
Good for grip strength and as a first step towards pull-ups.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand with the middle of your foot under the bar, feet hip-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees, grip the bar just outside your legs.
Straight back, chest up, brace your core and pull the bar close to the body until you stand upright.
Lower by pushing the hips back first.
Common mistake: a rounded back or letting the bar drift away from the legs.

exercises.name: Decline bench press
exercises.instructions:
Lie on a decline bench with your legs locked in.
Unrack the bar with straight arms over the chest.
Lower to the lower part of the chest and press up again.
Use a spotter if you can – it is hard to rack the bar yourself.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions:
Sink into a deep squat with your heels on the floor.
Push the knees apart with your elbows and keep your chest up.
Hold and breathe calmly.
Hold on to something in front of you if balance is an issue.

exercises.name: Diamond push-up
exercises.instructions:
Push-up position with the hands together under the chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Lower yourself with the elbows close to the body.
Push up to straight arms.
Easier variation: on your knees.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions:
Support yourself in the dip station with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward for more chest, more upright for more triceps.
Lower yourself until the upper arms are about horizontal and press up.
Do not go deeper than your shoulders can handle.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
exercises.instructions:
Place your forearm against the door frame with the elbow at shoulder height.
Step gently forward until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Hold and breathe calmly.
Switch sides halfway through.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, lean back and bring them up to your chest.
Press up so that the dumbbells meet above the chest.
Lower under control until the dumbbells are level with the chest, with the elbows slightly below shoulder height.
Common mistake: losing control at the bottom and letting the dumbbells drift apart.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions:
The dumbbells by your sides, palms facing forward.
Lift the dumbbells towards the shoulders, together or alternating.
Lower under control without swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell flyes
exercises.instructions:
Lie on the bench with the dumbbells above your chest and a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the arms in an arc out to the sides until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back in the same arc, as if hugging a tree.
Common mistake: too heavy a weight and straight arms – it strains the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand with the dumbbells by your sides and slightly bent elbows.
Raise out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly. A light weight is enough – do not swing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunges
exercises.instructions:
Stand with the dumbbells by your sides.
Take a long step forward and lower the rear knee towards the floor.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear delt fly
exercises.instructions:
Hinge forward with a straight back, the dumbbells hanging under the chest.
Raise out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrugs
exercises.instructions:
The dumbbells by your sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up, pause and lower.

exercises.name: Elliptical trainer
exercises.instructions:
Stand firmly on the pedals and hold the handles.
Move at an even pace with an upright posture.
Increase the resistance for a harder session.

exercises.name: Exercise bike
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the saddle so that the knee is slightly bent at the bottom position.
Pedal at an even pace and adjust the resistance.

exercises.name: Face pulls
exercises.instructions:
A rope on a pulley at face height.
Pull the rope towards your face and pull the hands apart, elbows high.
Good for the rear shoulders and posture.

exercises.name: Farmer’s walk
exercises.instructions:
Hold a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in each hand.
Walk with an upright posture and a braced core.
Walk for a set time or distance.

exercises.name: Frog stand
exercises.instructions:
Squat down with your hands on the floor, shoulder width apart.
Place your knees against the outside of your elbows.
Lean forward until your feet lift, and balance.
Put a cushion in front of you the first few times.

exercises.name: Front raise
exercises.instructions:
The dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Raise straight forward to shoulder height with almost straight arms.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.instructions:
The bar rests on the front of the shoulders, elbows high.
Keep the upper body upright and squat down.
Stand up with the elbows still high.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with bent knees and your feet on the floor.
Push the hips up and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell against your chest.
Squat down between the knees with an upright upper body.
Stand up by pushing with your feet.
Good for learning the squat movement.

exercises.name: Good mornings
exercises.instructions:
The bar on the upper back as in a squat, slightly bent knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back until the upper body is almost horizontal or you feel a stretch.
Stand up by bringing the hips forward. Start light.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.instructions:
Shoulders under the pads, back against the backrest.
Squat down under control as deep as you can with good form.
Press up without locking the knees.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.instructions:
Hold the dumbbells with the thumbs up.
Lift towards the shoulders with the elbows still.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions:
Put one heel on a low step with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hip with a straight back until you feel a stretch.
Hold and breathe calmly.
Switch legs halfway through.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Pull your knees to your chest and curl the pelvis up slightly.
Lower under control without swinging.
A step towards leg raises and toes to bar.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.instructions:
Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise the legs (straight or bent) towards the chest without swinging.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: Hiking
exercises.instructions:
Walk at an even pace over terrain.
Record time and, if you like, distance.

exercises.name: Hip abduction (machine)
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the pads against the outside of the knees.
Push the legs apart as far as you can.
Bring them together slowly.

exercises.name: Hip adduction (machine)
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the pads against the inside of the knees.
Squeeze the legs together.
Let them part slowly.

exercises.name: Hip circles (CARs)
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg holding something for balance.
Lift the knee forward, take it out to the side and back in as large a circle as you can.
Keep the rest of the body still – the movement happens only at the hip.
Go both directions and switch legs.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
Lift shoulders and legs off the floor with your arms stretched overhead.
Hold a slight banana shape without the lower back leaving the floor.
Easier: bend the knees or keep the arms by your sides.

exercises.name: Incline bench press
exercises.instructions:
Set the backrest to 30–45°. Feet on the floor, shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar to the upper chest, just below the collarbones.
Press straight up until the arms are straight over the shoulders.
Common mistake: too steep an incline, which moves the work to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.instructions:
Sit on a bench inclined about 45° with the arms hanging.
Bend the arms and lift the dumbbells without moving the upper arms.
Lower all the way.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell flyes
exercises.instructions:
Backrest at 30°, the dumbbells above the chest with slightly bent elbows.
Lower out to the sides in an arc until you feel a stretch.
Bring them together in the same arc.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.instructions:
Backrest at 30–45°. Dumbbells level with the upper chest.
Press up and slightly inwards until the arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to the chest.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.instructions:
Put your hands on a bench, a table or a wall.
Keep the body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest to the edge and push back.
The lower the support, the harder it is – a good step towards regular push-ups.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.instructions:
Hang under a bar at waist height with the body straight and the heels on the floor.
Pull your chest towards the bar.
Lower under control. The more horizontal the body, the harder.

exercises.name: Jump rope
exercises.instructions:
Jump lightly on the balls of your feet with the elbows close to the body.
Turn the rope with your wrists.
Start with short intervals.

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.instructions:
Squat to about half depth.
Jump up explosively, using your arms.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and go straight into the next squat.
Land quietly – it is a sign of control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.instructions:
Stand with a wide stance and the kettlebell in front of you.
Swing it back between the legs by hinging at the hips, straight back.
Extend the hips explosively so that the kettlebell swings to chest height.
The power comes from the hips, not the arms.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.instructions:
Support yourself on your hands and knees, hands slightly wider than the shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knee.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up.
Common mistake: letting the hips sag or pike up.

exercises.name: Knee to wall (ankle)
exercises.instructions:
Stand with one foot a short distance from the wall.
Bring the knee to the wall without the heel lifting.
Move the foot further back when it gets easy.
Ankle mobility, good before squats. Switch feet.

exercises.name: L-sit
exercises.instructions:
Support yourself on parallettes, a dip station or two chairs with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight out in front of you to horizontal.
Push the shoulders down and hold.
Easier: keep the knees bent (tuck L-sit).

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.instructions:
One end of the bar in a corner or holder, the other end by the shoulder.
Press the bar up and forward at an angle with one arm.
Lower under control and switch sides. Kind to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the thighs under the pads, grip the bar wide.
Lean slightly back and pull the bar to the upper chest.
Think of pulling the elbows down towards your sides.
Let the bar up slowly until the arms are straight.
Common mistake: pulling behind the neck or swinging with the upper body.

exercises.name: Lateral band walk
exercises.instructions:
Put a band around your knees or ankles and sink into a slight squat.
Take short steps to the side without the feet coming together.
Walk the same number of steps each way. One step each way counts as one rep.
Knees point forward, not in.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions:
The knee joint in line with the machine’s axis, the pad above the ankles.
Extend the legs until they are straight.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.instructions:
Sit with your back against the pad and your feet hip-width apart on the platform.
Release the lock and lower the platform until the knees are about 90°.
Press up without fully locking the knees.
Common mistake: the lower back lifting off the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable fly
exercises.instructions:
Set the pulleys low and step forward.
Bring the hands in an arc upwards and together at chest height.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your stomach with the pad just above the heels.
Bend the legs and pull the heels towards your buttocks.
Lower under control without lifting the hips.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with your hands under your buttocks.
Raise the legs straight towards the ceiling with the lower back against the floor.
Lower slowly without letting the feet touch the floor.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the seat so that the handles are level with the middle of the chest.
Back against the backrest, shoulder blades together.
Press forward to almost straight arms and return under control.

exercises.name: Machine dips
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the handles by your sides.
Press down until the arms are straight.
Come up under control.

exercises.name: Machine row
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the seat so that the handles are level with the lower chest.
Chest against the pad, pull the handles back.
Return under control.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the seat so that the handles are at shoulder height.
Press up and lower under control.

exercises.name: McGill curl-up
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with one leg bent and your hands under your lower back.
Lift head and shoulders a few centimetres with a neutral neck.
Hold briefly and lower.
A gentle ab exercise without bending the lower back.

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions:
Get into a push-up position.
Alternately pull the knees towards the chest at a high pace.
Keep the hips low and the back straight.

exercises.name: Muscle-up
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with a grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Do an explosive pull-up towards the lower chest and bring the hips slightly forward.
Turn the wrists over the bar and press up to straight arms above it.
Prerequisites: about 10 pull-ups and 10 dips. Lower under control.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
exercises.instructions:
Stand on a box or jump up so your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, ideally 3–5 seconds, to straight arms.
Step up again and repeat.
A good step towards your first pull-up.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
exercises.instructions:
Kneel with your heels anchored under something sturdy or held by a partner.
Lean forward as slowly as you can with the body straight from knee to head.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up.
Start with a short range; it strengthens the hamstrings and is common in injury prevention.

exercises.name: Nordic walking
exercises.instructions:
Walk with poles and plant the pole by the heel of the opposite foot.
Push off with the arms to involve the upper body.
Record time and, if you like, distance.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.instructions:
Support one knee and hand on a bench, back straight and horizontal.
Pull the dumbbell towards the hip with the elbow close to the body.
Lower until the arm is straight and feel the stretch in the back.
Do the same number on both sides.

exercises.name: Open book
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your side with knees bent and arms straight in front of you.
Sweep the top arm over your body to the other side, following your hand with your eyes.
Keep the knees together on the floor.
Return slowly. Mobility for the upper back.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.instructions:
The bar rests on the front of the shoulders, the grip just outside the shoulders.
Brace your glutes and core, press the bar straight up and move your head slightly back past the bar.
Lock the arms with the bar over the middle of the foot.
Common mistake: arching the lower back to get the weight up.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension
exercises.instructions:
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend up again with the elbows pointing forward.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.instructions:
Stand side-on to a pulley at chest height, the handle against the chest.
Press straight forward and resist the rotation.
Hold briefly, bring it back. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Pec deck (butterfly)
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the seat so that the arms are at shoulder height.
Bring the arms together in front of the chest with a slight bend in the elbows.
Pause briefly and return slowly.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
exercises.instructions:
Upper body almost horizontal, the bar resting on the floor.
Pull explosively up to the lower chest.
Lower the bar back to the floor between each repetition.

exercises.name: Petersen step-up
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg on a low step, the other leg hanging free.
Raise the heel of the standing leg and bend the knee forward over the toes.
Straighten the knee and lower the heel again.
A small movement that strengthens the muscle on the inside of the knee. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions:
Bring one knee forward with the shin angled across the mat and extend the other leg back.
Lower your hips towards the floor and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the glute of the front leg and breathe calmly.
Switch sides halfway through.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.instructions:
Start in a push-up position and walk your feet forward so the hips point up.
Lower your head to the floor between your hands.
Push up to straight arms.
Harder: feet on a box. A step towards the handstand push-up.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg with the other leg straight in front.
Sit down as deep as you can with the heel on the floor and arms forward.
Stand up without losing balance.
Easier: hold a door frame or sit down onto a box.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions:
Support yourself on your forearms and toes, elbows under the shoulders.
Body straight from head to heel, brace your stomach and glutes.
Hold the position. Stop when your form breaks.

exercises.name: Power clean
exercises.instructions:
Start as in the deadlift.
Pull explosively, extend the hips and shrug the shoulders.
Drop under the bar and catch it on the front of the shoulders.
Technically demanding – learn it with a coach if you can.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.instructions:
Upper arms against the pad.
Bend the arms and lift the weight.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with the palms facing forward, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull yourself up until the chin is over the bar, chest towards the bar.
Lower yourself under control to straight arms.
Easier variant: with a resistance band or in an assisted machine.

exercises.name: Push press
exercises.instructions:
Like the overhead press but with a short knee dip first.
Extend the legs explosively and use the momentum to press the bar up.
Lower under control to the shoulders.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions:
Hands slightly wider than the shoulders, body straight from head to heel.
Lower the chest towards the floor with the elbows angled back.
Press up without arching your lower back.
Easier variant: on your knees or with your hands on a bench.

exercises.name: Rack pulls
exercises.instructions:
Place the bar on supports at knee height.
Grip as in the deadlift, straight back and braced core.
Pull until you stand upright and lower back under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic
exercises.instructions:
Kneel with your body straight from knee to head.
Lean back as far as you can with control, without bending at the hip.
Squeeze the quads and pull yourself back up.
Start with a short range. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.instructions:
Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Move the arms back in an arc to shoulder height.
Return under control.

exercises.name: Ring row
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the rings with straight arms, body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to your hands, turning the palms in at the top.
Lower under control.
The more horizontal the body, the harder it is.

exercises.name: Ring support hold
exercises.instructions:
Jump up into the rings with straight arms and the rings beside your hips.
Push the shoulders down and turn the palms slightly out.
Hold still with a tight body.
The base for ring dips and muscle-ups. Easier: on a bar or dip station.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand upright with the bar in your hands and slightly bent knees.
Push the hips back and lower the bar along the thighs with a straight back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, usually just below the knees.
Stand up by bringing the hips forward.
Common mistake: bending the knees too much so that it becomes a regular deadlift.

exercises.name: Rowing machine
exercises.instructions:
Feet strapped in, grip the handle.
Push with the legs first, lean the upper body slightly back, then pull the arms towards the lower chest.
Return in reverse order: arms, upper body, legs.
Common mistake: pulling with the arms before the legs are straight.

exercises.name: Running
exercises.instructions:
Warm up with a walk or an easy jog.
Run at a pace you can keep for the whole session.
Record time and, if you like, distance.

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions:
Sit with bent knees and lean slightly back.
Rotate the upper body from side to side, with a weight if you like.
Count each side as one repetition.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Pull the shoulder blades down and together so the body rises a few centimetres – the arms stay straight.
Lower slowly back to a dead hang.
Common mistake: bending the arms and doing a small pull-up.

exercises.name: Scapular push-up
exercises.instructions:
Push-up position with straight arms.
Let the chest sink between the shoulder blades without bending the arms.
Then push away from the floor so the upper back rounds slightly.
Easier: on your knees or against a wall.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.instructions:
Sit with your feet against the supports and slightly bent knees.
Straight back, pull the handle towards your stomach and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Stretch the arms forward without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the pad over the knees and the balls of the feet on the platform.
Lower the heels and rise up on your toes.
Move slowly all the way.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell press
exercises.instructions:
Sit with the backrest almost vertical, the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press up until the arms are almost straight.
Lower to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.instructions:
The knees in line with the machine’s axis, the locking pad over the thighs.
Press the pad down with your heels as far as possible.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your side supported on the forearm and feet.
Lift the hips so that the body becomes straight.
Hold and switch sides.

exercises.name: Side-lying external rotation
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Elbow against your side at 90°, ideally with a towel underneath.
Raise the weight by rotating at the shoulder, without the elbow leaving your body.
Lower slowly. A very light weight is enough. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg on the edge of a step, holding something for balance.
Lower the heel below the step.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and lower slowly.
Harder: hold a dumbbell.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other leg pulled up.
Push through the heel and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulder to knee.
Hold for a second and lower under control.
Common mistake: letting the hip tilt to the side.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg goes back, straight back.
Stand up and do all repetitions before switching legs.

exercises.name: Skater squat
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg and bend the other back.
Lower yourself until the back knee almost touches the floor.
Stand up on the front leg.
Easier: a cushion under the knee and a shorter range.

exercises.name: Ski erg
exercises.instructions:
Grip the handles above your head.
Pull down with the arms and core while bending slightly at the knees and hips.
Stand up and bring the arms up again.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
exercises.instructions:
Lie on the bench with the bar (preferably an EZ bar) above your chest.
Bend the elbows and lower the bar towards your forehead.
Extend up again. Upper arms still.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.instructions:
Grip the sled’s poles and lean forward.
Drive forward with short, powerful steps.
Go for a set time or distance.

exercises.name: Smith machine bench press
exercises.instructions:
Position the bench so that the bar lands on the lower part of the chest.
Twist the bar free, lower under control and press up.
Lock the bar in the hooks when the set is done.
Advantage: safe to go heavy without a spotter. Drawback: the path is fixed.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.instructions:
Place your feet slightly in front of the bar.
Twist the bar free and squat down under control.
Stand up and lock the bar in the hooks after the set.

exercises.name: Spanish squat
exercises.instructions:
Anchor a strong band to something sturdy and step in so it sits behind your knees.
Lean back into the band and sit down with the shins vertical.
Hold the position with the weight on your heels.
Loads the quads with little stress on the knee joint. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Spin bike
exercises.instructions:
Adjust the saddle and handlebars to your body.
Vary resistance and cadence, seated and standing.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.instructions:
The bar on the upper back, feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Breathe in, brace your core and bend at the hips and knees at the same time.
The knees follow the direction of the toes; go as deep as you can with a straight back, ideally until the hips are at knee height.
Stand up by pushing with the whole foot.
Use the safety bars in the rack when you go heavy.

exercises.name: Stair climber
exercises.instructions:
Step at an even pace and keep the upper body upright.
Hold the handles lightly for balance, not to take weight off.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.instructions:
The balls of the feet on the edge of the platform, heels free.
Lower the heels as far as possible.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can and pause at the top.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.instructions:
Put one foot on a box or bench at knee height.
Step up by pushing with the top foot.
Step down under control.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Stand in front of a high pulley with a straight bar or rope.
With almost straight arms, bring the bar in an arc down towards the thighs.
Bring it up slowly to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.instructions:
Pick up a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand.
Walk with an upright body without leaning to the side.
Switch hands halfway through.
Trains the sides of the core and the grip.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Wide stance with the toes pointing out, grip the bar inside the knees.
The knees point in the same direction as the toes, straight back.
Push the floor away and stand up until you are upright.
Lower under control with the same technique.

exercises.name: Superman hold
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your stomach with your arms stretched forward.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold with your eyes on the floor and the neck straight.
Common mistake: arching hard and throwing the head back.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.instructions:
Swim at a pace you can keep.
Record time and, if you like, distance.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.instructions:
Straddle the bar and grip the handle.
Bend forward with a straight back.
Pull the handle towards the chest and lower under control.

exercises.name: Terminal knee extension (TKE)
exercises.instructions:
Anchor a band at knee height and loop it behind your knee.
Stand with the knee slightly bent against the band's pull.
Straighten the knee fully and squeeze the quads, hold for a second.
Release slowly. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Thrusters
exercises.instructions:
Front squat down with the bar on the shoulders.
Stand up explosively and press the bar overhead in the same movement.
Lower to the shoulders and go straight down into the next squat.

exercises.name: Tibialis raise
exercises.instructions:
Lean your back against the wall with your feet a little forward.
Lift the toes and forefoot towards the shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly.
Strengthens the front of the shin, which helps take load off the knee.

exercises.name: Toes to bar
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with straight arms.
Raise straight or nearly straight legs until your toes touch the bar.
Lower under control and damp the swing.
Easier: knee raises or leg raises to horizontal.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand in the middle of the trap bar and grip the handles.
Straight back, bend at the hips and knees.
Stand up by pushing with your legs until you are upright.
Often kinder to the lower back than a regular deadlift.

exercises.name: Treadmill
exercises.instructions:
Start walking at a calm pace and increase gradually.
Do not hold the handles when you run.
An incline makes the session harder without a higher speed.

exercises.name: Triceps kickback
exercises.instructions:
Hinge forward with a straight back, the upper arm along the body.
Extend the arm back until it is straight.
Bend back under control. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.instructions:
Stand facing a high pulley with a bar or rope.
Elbows close to the body, press down until the arms are straight.
Let the hands come up under control without moving the elbows.

exercises.name: Tuck front lever
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar and pull your knees to your chest.
Press the bar down with straight arms until your back is horizontal.
Hold with a tight core and shoulder blades down.
Next step: extend one leg at a time.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back with the kettlebell on a straight arm towards the ceiling.
Rise step by step to standing with the arm straight and your eyes on the weight.
Go back the same way. Start very light.

exercises.name: Upright row
exercises.instructions:
Stand with the bar in front of the thighs, shoulder-width grip.
Pull the bar along the body to the lower chest with the elbows high.
Lower under control. Skip it if it hurts your shoulders.

exercises.name: Walking
exercises.instructions:
Walk at a pace where you get slightly out of breath but can still talk.
Record time and, if you like, distance.

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions:
Walk forward with long lunge steps.
Rear knee close to the floor, front knee over the foot.
Count repetitions per leg.

exercises.name: Wall handstand hold
exercises.instructions:
Place your hands a hand's width from the wall and walk your feet up the wall.
Straight arms, push away from the floor and brace your core and glutes.
Hold and breathe. Come down under control.
Start facing the wall (walking up backwards) if that feels safer.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.instructions:
Lean your back against the wall and slide down until the knees are at about 90°.
Knees over the ankles and weight evenly on the feet.
Hold the position.
Easier: stand higher up. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: Wall slide
exercises.instructions:
Stand with your back and arms against the wall, elbows at 90°.
Slide the arms up the wall as far as you can without arching your back.
Bring them back down, gently squeezing the shoulder blades.
It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions:
Step forward into a deep lunge and put your hands on the floor inside the front foot.
Bring the elbow towards the inside of the front foot.
Then rotate the same arm up towards the ceiling and follow it with your eyes.
Switch sides. One side counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Wrist curl
exercises.instructions:
Forearms on the thighs or a bench, wrists over the edge.
Bend the wrists up and down with a light weight.
Move slowly.

exercises.name: Y-T-W raise
exercises.instructions:
Lie face down on an incline bench with very light dumbbells or none.
Raise the arms in a Y, lower; in a T, lower; and pull the elbows back into a W.
One round of Y-T-W counts as one rep.
Thumbs up and shoulder blades down. It should not hurt. If you feel pain: stop, and follow your physiotherapist's advice if you are injured.
